svg.title: tdm-dash · dashboard mount plate, 1:1
svg.text: github.com/frascella-dev/tdm-dash · generated by hardware/drawings/generate.py from hardware/enclosure/enclosure.scad, do not edit by hand
M6 × 25 hex screw, head on the pod side
fairing stay, tab of the original cluster
original nut 95316-06600, or an M6 nyloc
Print at 100 % (actual size): this bar measures 50 mm
Print the PDF at 100 % on A4 landscape and check the 50 mm
bar. Glue the print on a 3 mm aluminum plate (5754 or 6082,
blank 180 × 97 mm), center-punch the hole centers, drill, then
Seen from the front of the bike, as it goes on. Three M5 × 10
button head screws hold it in the inserts of the pod lugs; the two
M6 screws take the place of the studs of the original cluster.
Put the M6 screws in before screwing the plate to the pod: their
heads stay between the plate and the display unit. The notches
keep the four pod screws reachable.
On the bike every M6 screw goes through an original grommet
of the fairing stay, with the collar inside, then the washer and
the nut: tighten until the collar is clamped, about 7 Nm
Orange values are [TO VERIFY] on the bike
position, the grommet. Set them in enclosure.scad, run
cad-export.sh and generate.py, and try the fit template before
